producer_report.summary: Added `athena check-reading` and a replay of the newest 50 accepted readings through base and candidate builds, stored as the new typed record `athena.replay/1` (`<job>/replay.json`). Root cause: a refusal-rule change was only judged on the new job's own reading, so a rule that wrongly refused many past readings could land. The replay runs in `check_and_verify` after the checks and the producer build-directory removal, and before the verifier-brief inputs and the disk gate. It makes no model call. More than 10% newly refused adds an Athena Blocker finding that names the list, so the verdict is Fail and the job is Rejected. Exactly 10% is not held, and a candidate whose criteria state a higher refusal rate is intended is not held; the replay is recorded in every case. An empty history, nested run, fake driver, failed build or missing subcommand gives `no replay: <reason>`, never a pass. The verifier brief gets a capped "Replay of accepted readings" section (20 entries, reasons cut to 200 characters, "and N more"). The 10% threshold is the code constant `REPLAY_HOLD_PERCENT`. No config, defaults or workflow file changed, no existing reading rule changed, no replay.md, no skip switch. The first replay of this very change will say `no replay: the base build has no check-reading subcommand`.

open_issues: store.rs and docs/records.md are not in the expected-deliverables list. store.rs was needed (plan decision 1: two arms and a field, or Records::load panics); docs/records.md gets one line so the layout table matches the new record.

The production path (`replay_checkers` without a seam: materialize the base and candidate trees, `cargo build -p athena-cli --bin athena --locked` into a shared target directory, `check-reading --help` probe) is not run by any test, because fake-driver tests skip it by design. Only its parts are tested: the stub-binary `BinaryChecker` test, and the output parser. A real run needs the repository to have `crates/athena-cli`; otherwise it records `no replay: the <side> tree has no athena-cli package to build`.
`check-reading` does not replay the earlier-attempt rule (`check_prior_result_and_scope`), as the criterion specifies; retry readings are checked as first attempts.

'Intended' is a phrase match on the criteria text (a fixed list in `INTENDED_REFUSAL_PHRASES`), not a typed reading field, because the reader schema is outside the deliverables. A criterion like 'must not refuse more readings' would match 'refuse more' and so not hold the job; the record keeps `intended` and the full list for a maintainer to see.
The replay does not add an entry to the verification record's `inputs` names, to avoid changing every pipeline test's recorded inputs; the verifier brief carries the section.
mistakes: My first reading.rs candidate-rule phrase list followed the plan's bare 'refusal rate' and 'newly refused'. I tightened it to 'higher refusal rate', 'higher rate of refusal', 'refuse more' and similar, because the bare phrases would match this job's own criteria text and any criterion that merely mentions the rate.
Two store.rs and reading.rs test names first lacked the filter substring the plan's commands use (`replay_record_loads`, `replay_window`); I renamed them.
learnings: `Records::load` panics (expect 'every other record names its job') for any record kind whose `job_of` arm is missing, and `JobRecords::add` silently drops an unlisted kind; neither is checked by the compiler. A new per-job record kind needs both arms plus a field.
`message()` in commits.rs takes three arguments (subject, body, trailers).
JobId suffixes are 4 Crockford base32 characters, so digits are safe for generated fixture ids.
The existing test `a_fake_job_takes_its_baseline_before_the_producer...` counts the UI lines between dispatch and landing; the new `replay     ...` line made it 7, and I updated it.
`replay_cases` sorts by job id (newest first), so the 'newest' window follows the id's timestamp, not commit order.
